thread:
pagerduty-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty: SEV2 triggered for Oberon Logistics (dedicated eu-west-2 cluster) - multiple 504s detected on inference-route /v1/generate, alerting on-call.

morgan_h: seeing 504 spikes and elevated tail latency in the eu-west pool. dashboard shows steady errors starting ~T-12m. paging @oncall.

oncall: I'm up. grabbing logs now. any customer impact list?

morgan_h: preliminary customer fanout: Oberon Logistics (dedicated), small number of VIP enterprise API keys -- request IDs show backend 504s Nginx -> upstream timeouts.

pagerduty-bot: Incident assigned to oncall (sanjay) and ops_lead.

sanjay: taking it. quick checklist: 1) confirm scope, 2) check recent deploys, 3) open status page draft, 4) notify CS for customer comms. I will run a grep across access logs.

jordan_se: I see a surge of long seq-length requests from Oberon keys that are causing CPU hogging on a subset of pods. probable hot-shard on ded-gpu-12.

morgan_h: recorded sample request IDs: req_8c9... req_8f2... shared to #eng-runtime-logs.

nora_support: FYI Emily, Oberon support asked for ETA already. They reported elevated 5xxs 8 minutes ago.

emily_cs: thanks, nora. working on a tailored message for Oberon — hold until we have confirmed impact and an initial mitigation ETA.

sanjay: mitigation plan: scale up ded-gpu-12 pool by +2 nodes, and temporarily route Oberon traffic to ded-gpu-14 (same region) if warm capacity available. also enable temporary request-timeout shortening to 45s to fail fast and reduce queueing. applying fixes now.

ops_lead: go ahead. Jordan, coordinate with autoscaler to provision nodes; if provisioning > 5m, we'll fallback to routing policy.

jordan_se: autoscaler triggered scale request. provisioning started. estimated ready in ~160s.

statusbot: Status page draft created (private) - https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/3467890123/draft - includes current state and impact.

morgan_h: putting together internal comms template for SRE/CS handoff. draft below:

```
Internal update (SRE -> CS / Account execs)
Time: T+14m
Severity: SEV2
Summary: Oberon Logistics experiencing 504s on dedicated eu-west-2 inference cluster affecting generation requests for a subset of API keys. Root cause under investigation; suspected hotspot on ded-gpu-12 due to long-sequence models.
Impact: Affected customers: Oberon Logistics (enterprise-dedicated). Some requests returning 504 or timing out; retries may exacerbate load.
Mitigation in progress: scaling pool +2 nodes; routing subset of traffic to alternate pool; reducing backend request timeout to 45s to prevent head-of-line queueing.
Next steps: monitor error rate and latency; if errors persist, perform rolling restart on ded-gpu-12 pods and/or apply model throttling config for Oberon keys.
ETA: initial mitigation in 5-10m; full mitigation TBD.
Contacts: oncall (sanjay), ops_lead (ops_lead), customer success (emily_cs).
```

emily_cs: LGTM. I'll use the Internal update to message Oberon's technical contact after we confirm mitigation success in the next update. Draft external message below — please flag any technical inaccuracies: 

```
Customer notice (Oberon Logistics)
Time: T+15m
Headline: We are investigating errors for some requests to the eu-west inference cluster.
Impact: Some API requests (POST /v1/generate) may return errors or take longer than usual. This affects Oberon Logistics dedicated cluster only.
What we are doing: Our on-call team is scaling capacity, routing requests to alternate nodes, and implementing timeouts to reduce retries.
What you can expect: Reduced errors for most requests within 10 minutes. We will follow up with a post-incident summary and any recommended client-side retry/backoff adjustments.
Contact: Your technical contact (emily_cs) and our on-call (sanjay) are available for escalation.
```

ops_lead: please include the support ticket link when you send external comms. also add "Do not change client-side retry aggressively while we mitigate" to avoid amplifying load.

sanjay: autoscaler reported nodes ready. starting routing policy to shift Oberon traffic -> ded-gpu-14. Applying iptables / routing rule now.

jordan_se: routing applied. tailing logs now. error rate dropping from ~12% -> 3% in the last 90s.

morgan_h: good sign. update status page to reflect partial mitigation. propose status: "service degradation, partial restoration in progress".

statusbot: Status page updated to: "Degraded performance in eu-west ded cluster affecting a small number of enterprise customers. Partial mitigation in progress." Link: https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/3467890123

emily_cs: sending tailored note to Oberon now (cc ops_lead). I'll paste CS message here for records:

"Hi Anders — quick update: we're seeing elevated 5xxs on your eu-west dedicated cluster. We applied routing changes and scaled capacity; error rate is dropping. We'll confirm once fully resolved and share an RCA. If you see any urgent regressions, reply here or call my cell." :phone:

nora_support: Oberon replied: "Thanks — seeing improvement now, will monitor. Please include any client-side guidance on retries."

morgan_h: action item: create a short guidance snippet for Oberon to reduce retries/backoff windows until we confirm stable.

sanjay: agreed. also scheduling a rolling restart of ded-gpu-12 pods at T+40m to clear possible stuck processes if error rate doesn't go below 1%.

jordan_se: logs show a handful of long-running model decodes from Oberon keys (>= 4k tokens). added a temporary model throttling policy for their API keys limiting max input length to 3k tokens for 30m.

emily_cs: noted — adding that to the customer message: "We have temporarily limited max input length to 3k tokens for your account to stabilize traffic; this will be rolled back once normal error rates return."

ops_lead: excellent. make sure the policy change is tracked in the incident ticket and tagged for rollback.

morgan_h: incident timeline note added to ticket. current metrics: error rate 1.2%, p95 latency normalizing.

statusbot: Incident status -> Monitoring.

emily_cs: sending updated customer blurb with throttling note.

nora_support: Oberon confirms: "Throttling is fine, errors are low. Thanks. Please send RCA."

sanjay: will keep monitoring for 30m. if error rate holds <1% for 20m, we'll start postmortem prep and draft customer RCA.

morgan_h: assigning postmortem owner: jordan_se. please include: root cause hypothesis (hot-shard from long-seq decodes), autoscale latency improvements, routing fallback behavior, and mitigation timeline.

jordan_se: accepted. I'll include logs, flamegraphs, and the throttling config we applied.

ops_lead: closing action items: CS notified and customer acknowledged, routing mitigation applied, nodes scaled, temporary throttling in place, scheduling rolling restart if needed. will update when we move to resolved.

statusbot: When resolved, please post the final status page update and include the RCA link.

morgan_h: thanks team. tagging this thread for incident archive: incident-3467890123.

oncall: handing off monitoring to night oncall at T+55m. leaving notes in the ticket.

emily_cs: final note: Oberon asked for a post-incident summary for their compliance team. we'll include timeline + guidance for client retry/backoff and recommend using exponential backoff with jitter.

morgan_h: acknowledged. closing live coordination.

pagerduty-bot: Incident resolved by oncall (sanjay) at T+58m - status moved to MONITORING -> RESOLVED once metrics stable.

morgan_h: moving to post-incident follow-up items in #postmortems. thanks all. :white_check_mark:
